svg.title: A change in remuneration, with balances fixed
svg.desc: At fixed total balances of 2,264.080 billion euros, the 2 percent ratio scenario raises required reserves from 177.314 to 354.935 billion. About 177.6 billion would become unremunerated. Balances above the requirement are gross balances, distinct from official excess liquidity net of marginal lending.
